description: Retroactive PRD synthesized from .claude/PHASE{1..5}_COMPLETE.md + .claude/ALCHEMY2_TDD_COMPLETE.md on 2026-06-09 during /upm sync strategic gate. Captures the 5-phase TDD refactor of the React prototype into the alchemy2/ directory: directory scaffolding, frontend cleanup, backend consolidation (6 services → 1 Express API), Docker simplification, Supabase configuration. RED-phase TDD complete with 706 tests written across phases. Local-only — does not propagate to Plane SFA project (which tracks sfa/, not this repo).

userStories.title: Phase 1 — Setup, cleanup, and scaffolding
userStories.description: Establish alchemy2/ directory structure, clean up unused React components and dependencies, consolidate the 6-microservice backend into a unified Express API, simplify Docker, and configure Supabase as the data layer (replacing Redis + custom queue).
acceptanceCriteria: alchemy2/ directory tree created with 21 directories and 28 config files (frontend, backend, docker, supabase migrations, e2e/integration/unit test scaffolds)
Frontend components reduced 60 → 7 (-88%): button, dialog, input, label, sonner, toast, toggle retained
Frontend Radix dependencies reduced 27 → 5 (-81%), total deps 57 → 26 (-54%)
Backend consolidated 6 services → 1 unified Express + Socket.IO API (-83%)
Docker files reduced 81 → 9 (-89%) using shared base images + multi-stage builds
Supabase schema with 6 tables, 16 indexes, 18 RLS policies, 2 storage buckets
Replaces Redis + PostgreSQL with Supabase (Realtime channels, Auth, Storage)

userStories.title: Phase 2 — Backend migration (TDD RED-GREEN-REFACTOR)
userStories.description: Migrate all backend route handlers and Python workers to the new unified architecture using strict TDD. Each route gets a test file written first (RED), then implementation (GREEN), then refactor.
acceptanceCriteria: Spotify routes: 7 tests, ≥95% coverage (achieved 96.8%)
Download routes: 32 tests, ≥95% coverage (achieved 95.0%)
Processing routes (Demucs worker): 51 tests, ≥95% coverage (achieved 95.0%)
Analysis routes (librosa worker): 45 tests, ≥95% coverage (achieved 96.5%)
All 4 route groups migrated end-to-end, 135 total tests, average 95.8% coverage
Python workers (Demucs, analyzer) integrated via subprocess + structured stderr capture
Service layer extracted from inline handlers

userStories.title: Phase 3 — Frontend migration (TDD)
userStories.description: Migrate React components, hooks, and integration helpers to the new alchemy2 frontend using strict TDD. Components, hooks, and integration utilities each get their own test suites.
acceptanceCriteria: Components: AudioPlayer (45 tests, 98.5% coverage), TrackLibrary (38 tests, 97.2%), JobProgress (32 tests, 96.8%) — 115 tests, 97.5% avg
Hooks: useJobProgress (10), useSupabase (10), useAudioPlayer (16), useTracks (11) — 47 tests, 96.95% avg
Integrations: API Client (24), Realtime Manager (16), Storage Helpers (18), Workflow Orchestrator (15) — 73 tests, 95.0% avg
Total: 235 tests, 96.5% average coverage (exceeds 95% target)
All components, hooks, and integrations implemented through GREEN phase
Real-time updates via Supabase Realtime channels (replaces Socket.IO direct from backend)

userStories.title: Phase 4 — Infrastructure & deployment (TDD RED phase)
userStories.description: Write infrastructure-as-code tests and Supabase migration tests in TDD RED phase. Establishes deployment surface contracts before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Docker compose multi-service tests defined
Supabase migration tests cover all 6 tables + RLS policies
Storage bucket policy tests written
CI/CD workflow tests defined
All tests intentionally in RED state — implementation tracked separately
Test files reference real schema, not mocks

userStories.title: Phase 5 — End-to-end integration tests (TDD RED phase)
userStories.description: Define E2E scenarios spanning the full pipeline (Spotify URL → download → stem separation → analysis → library) as TDD RED tests, establishing acceptance contracts for the integrated alchemy2 system.
acceptanceCriteria: End-to-end scenario: paste Spotify URL → metadata fetch → audio download → Demucs separation → librosa analysis → library entry
Real-time progress tracking across the full pipeline via Supabase Realtime
Error recovery scenarios covered (network failure, Demucs crash, analyzer timeout)
Multi-track concurrent processing scenarios defined
All E2E tests in RED state pending unified integration
Test suite total across all 5 phases: 706 tests, 85-97.5% coverage targets
